svg.desc: Figure 1. SHMtrace: control-calibrated somatic hypermutation calling, from inputs and read preparation through calling, quality checks and outputs.

tspan.tspan: Each base is judged only by its own quality
score. Sequencing errors that recur at one
pass this test and are wrongly counted as
SHM mutations, and reads from one animal
over-length reads and reads averaging > 0.01 errors per base
minimap2 against target and paralog references; chimeras out
random draw of the same number of usable reads per library
base quality; a margin chosen by
each control called vs the others
